goal: Verify install portability for clean Windows and macOS checkouts without local absolute path assumptions.

added_layers.purpose: Noninteractive prerequisite, repo layout, and writability validation without downloads.
Run Windows and macOS install checks on GitHub runners.
Shared local/CI audit, runtime override, compileall, frontend build, pytest, web health, and optional model smoke.
Prevent accidental removal of dry-run, CI, and smoke hooks.

local_evidence: Static install portability smoke passed locally.
CI-level install portability smoke passed locally with 131 pytest tests passing.
Post-install web smoke passed locally and restored the web server.
Frontend build passed locally with an existing large chunk warning.
limits: macOS dry-run and CI matrix are implemented but not executed on this Windows host.
GitHub Actions execution is pending until changes are pushed.
Clean install on a separate Windows or macOS machine is still manual.
Model smoke requires installed model files and is not run by default in CI.
